assessment.population: Mice in the NIA Interventions Testing Program. No human lifespan data
assessment.plain: Extends lifespan in mice. Never measured in people.
assessment.summary: Rapamycin extends lifespan in mice, including when started in middle age. No human study has measured lifespan.
assessment.rationale: Illustrative grade for design review only. Not assessed against the rubric.
assessment.limitations: Animal results may not translate to people. Rapamycin suppresses parts of the immune system at transplant doses.
